Вот что может помешать обходу. У каждого: Here is what may interfere with the bypass. Each item explains what it means and what to do about it.
Эта программа уже держит драйвер WinDive: This program already holds the WinDivert driver. Two bypasses cannot edit the same packets: the engine either won't start at all, or will fire only every other time — and a strategy that actually works will look broken.
Закройте её полностью — не только окно,: Close it completely — not just the window, but also the icon by the clock (right-click → exit). If it's set to run at startup, disable that, or it will come back after a reboot. Then turn the bypass on here.
VPN заворачивает весь трафик в свой тунн: A VPN wraps all traffic into its tunnel. The engine edits packets after that, and they reach the provider sealed inside the tunnel — there's nothing left to bypass, so the bypass looks broken even if the strategy is correct.
Отключитесь от VPN, пока пользуетесь обх: Disconnect from the VPN while you use the bypass. The bypass solves the same problem as a VPN — you don't need both together. If the VPN is required for work, use them one at a time, not at once.
Сетевой адаптер туннеля включён. Такое б: A tunnel network adapter is enabled. This happens even with the VPN client closed: the adapter stays in the system and keeps diverting some traffic past the engine.
Выйдите из VPN-клиента полностью. Если а: Quit the VPN client completely. If the adapter is left over from an already-uninstalled program, disable it: Windows Settings → Network & Internet → Advanced network settings → select the adapter → “Disable”.
winws2 — это то, что собственно обходит: winws2 is what actually bypasses the block; without it the “Enable the bypass” button won't work. It usually downloads itself on the first launch, so if it still isn't there, the download failed.
Откройте «Настройки» → «Проверить обновл: Open “Settings” → “Check for updates” and wait for the download to finish.
